d:
Bihar ki rajniti men nishant kumar ko lekar siyasi halchal tej hai. RJD ki or se lagatar ophar die ja rahe hain aur unhen apne pale men lane ki koshishon ki charcha hai. lekin saval hai ki kya nishant kumar apne pita nitish kumar ke bina bihar ki rajniti men koee bara phaisla le paenge? kya RJD ke ophar se bihar men nae rajnitik samikran banenge ya nitish kumar ke bina nishant ke lie siyasi rah aasan nahin hogi?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
